physical_protocol.retry_observation_semantics: slots searches_remaining/recoveries_remaining are 0/1 time-only permission; real counts retained in controller/environment evidence

geometry.extrema_scope: initial through driving decision, inclusive; first main-fit also checks holding tail through task end
geometry.projection_definition: entry_radius - pin_radius - XY distance(tip center, paired hole); conservative cap projection only, no axial overlap requirement

exact_referee_sampling.caveat: Best actual entry clearance means best checked frame; not an exhaustive 2 ms or native 0.2 ms maximum. Main-fit first occurrence scans every candidate saved 2 ms frame.
